# ICU4C

Files from **ICU4C 79.1**: `icu4c-79.1-sources.tgz` (28,162,455 bytes) from `https://github.com/unicode-org/icu/releases/tag/release-79.1`, released 2026-10-22. Downloaded on 2026-11-25 with the owner's approval. Its SHA-512 matched the release's `SHASUM512.txt`, and the archive's SHA-256 is `06fa63ecb521048f8082f12ad988f6b678d90cbd88aafce24cbc94902b191d99`.

**Kept, unmodified:** `source/common/`, `source/stubdata/`, `LICENSE`.

**Generated by ICU's own tool:** `data/icudt79l.dat` (3,452,672 bytes, 38 items). It is the release's prebuilt package `source/data/in/icudt79l.dat` (33.6 MB), reduced by ICU's `icupkg` to the items listed in [`cmake/RavenIcuData.txt`](../../cmake/RavenIcuData.txt):
- the break-iterator rules;
- the break dictionaries for Thai, Lao, Khmer, Burmese, Chinese and Japanese;
- the emoji and Indic layout properties.

`scripts/UpdateIcu.cmake` builds `icupkg` from the same release (`cmake/IcuTools`) and regenerates the file. No item is changed; the others are only left out.

**License:** the Unicode License V3 ([LICENSE](LICENSE)), staged as `Licenses/ICU-LICENSE.txt`.

## Rule: never edit these files

Nothing in this folder except this README is changed by hand, so an update is a clean replacement. Its `MANIFEST.txt`, written only by the update script, records every file, and CI checks the copy against it (`scripts/CheckVendored.cmake`). Every Raven setting lives in [`cmake/RavenIcu.cmake`](../../cmake/RavenIcu.cmake):

- **Library:** a static `RavenIcu` from `source/common/` and the stub data entry point. ICU's `i18n` library (plural rules, number formatting) joins when string tables arrive (decision U5).
- **Compiled out (`UCONFIG_NO_*`):** file access, converters, services, IDNA, collation, formatting, transliteration and regular expressions. Raven loads the data file itself and hands it to ICU with `udata_setCommonData`.
- **Warnings:** Raven's warning level does not apply to third-party code.
- **UTF-8:** sources compile as UTF-8. One file has Japanese comments, which MSVC otherwise misreads in the Korean code page.

**Used for:** bidirectional order, script runs, line, word and grapheme breaks, and normalization in the text stack (decisions U4 and U5), through `Private/Text/`. Public engine headers never include it.

**Adoption condition (U5):** ICU must build unmodified. Verified with MSVC 14.51 on 2026-11-25. Clang is not yet verified (macOS and Linux, M4).

## Updating to a new release

1. Download `icu4c-<version>-sources.tgz` and check it against the release's `SHASUM512.txt`.
2. Run `cmake -DSOURCE=<extracted icu folder> -P scripts/UpdateIcu.cmake` from a developer environment.
3. Set `RAVEN_ICU_VERSION` in `cmake/RavenIcu.cmake`. If the major version changed, update the data file name the text stack loads.
4. Build in Debug and Release, then check line breaking in Thai and Korean, and right-to-left text.
